benchmark: structure-only: coherent 2D turbulence vs IAAFT surrogates

spectral_view.description: spectral view only (spectrum slope/peak + graph-Laplacian eigenvalues)

topological_view.description: topological view only (sublevel-set PH, H0/H1 statistics)

power_spectrum.description: full log radial power spectrum (leak detector)

baselines_union.description: all non-topological baselines concatenated (no raw pixels)

topo_persistence_image.description: persistence images of H0/H1 (2 x 10x10), full-resolution field

topo_betti_curves.description: Betti curves beta0/beta1 on 33 thresholds, full-resolution field

topo_multiscale.description: multi-scale filtration (Gaussian sigma 1/2/4/8 px), 16 summaries per scale

topo_rich_all.description: persistence images + Betti curves + multi-scale filtration

descriptor_rich.description: spectral view + all richer topological views

topological_view_fullres.description: topological view at full 256^2 resolution (not pre-registered)

descriptor_fullres_topo.description: descriptor with full-resolution topological view (not pre-registered)

verdict_overall_rule: overall = strict verdict: the specified baselines are blind by construction on this benchmark, so only the strict comparison tests superiority over strong baselines
